demo.title: blockchain-iq-trade-gate.sh
demo.code:
# Blockchain IQ Trade Gate: GO, CAUTION or HOLD before a trade. $0.01 in USDC on Base over x402.
# Unpaid, this returns HTTP 402 with the payment terms
curl -s "https://x402.bankr.bot/0xd9a04eba22b8b6ba00c8ba191fdb20b719d5258d/biq-trade-gate?symbol=ETH&side=buy"

# Paid call with the Bankr CLI
bankr x402 call "https://x402.bankr.bot/0xd9a04eba22b8b6ba00c8ba191fdb20b719d5258d/biq-trade-gate?symbol=ETH&side=buy"

setup: No signup or API key. You need an x402-capable agent or wallet with USDC on Base.
Before a trade, call the gate with the token symbol and side.
On HTTP 402, check the host, token and the $0.01 ceiling, then pay and retry to receive the verdict as JSON.
